question: "My Nike Air Max 270 has faulty stitching after one week. What should I do?"
reason: asks about a policy regarding faulty products
answer:
If your Nike Air Max 270 has developed faulty stitching after one week, you should contact Customer Support as soon as possible. Here are the steps you should follow:

1. Reach out to Customer Support via email at support@jdretaildemo.com or call +44 800 555 1000.
2. Provide photographs of the faulty stitching where appropriate.
3. Include proof of purchase in your communication.
4. If requested, return the product for inspection.

Each claim is assessed individually, and you may be eligible for a repair, replacement, or refund based on the outcome of the inspection.

JD Sports Product Quality, Warranty & Care Policy

1. Product Quality Commitment

At JD Sports, we are committed to providing high-quality footwear, clothing, and sports accessories. If a product develops a manufacturing fault after purchase, customers may be eligible for a repair, replacement, or refund in accordance with UK consumer rights and our quality assessment process.

All claims are reviewed individually to ensure a fair and consistent outcome.



2. Manufacturing Defects

A manufacturing defect is a fault that results from the production process rather than normal use. Examples include:

Sole separation during normal use 

Faulty stitching or loose seams 

Defective zippers or fasteners 

Broken eyelets or lace loops 

Material flaws present at the time of purchase 

Each product is carefully inspected before a decision is made.



3. Normal Wear and Tear

The following conditions are considered normal wear and are not classified as manufacturing defects:

Worn shoe soles

If you believe a product has developed a manufacturing fault: 
• Contact Customer Support as soon as possible.  
• Provide photographs where appropriate.  
• Include proof of purchase.  
• Return the product for inspection if requested.  
Each claim is assessed individually. 
 
Sustainability 
To help extend the life of your products: 
• Wash garments only when necessary.  
• Use lower washing temperatures where appropriate.  
• Repair minor damage where possible.  
• Donate or recycle unwanted clothing.  
• Recycle packaging responsibly.  
Following these practices helps reduce environmental impact.

JD Retail Returns & Refund Policy 
Document Version: 1.2 
Last Updated: 20 July 2026 
 
Returns Policy 
We want every customer to be satisfied with their purchase. If you are not completely happy with 
your order, you may return eligible items within 30 days of the purchase date. 
 
Eligibility 
Products are eligible for return if they: 
• Are returned within 30 days of purchase.  
• Are in their original condition.  
• Include all original tags and packaging.  
• Have not been worn outside.  
• Are accompanied by proof of purchase.  
 
Non-Returnable Items 
The following items cannot be returned unless faulty: 
• Underwear  
• Swimwear  
• Gift Cards  
• Personalised products  
• Opened personal care products  
 
Faulty Products 
If an item is faulty or damaged, customers should contact Customer Support within 14 days of 
receiving the order . 
Faulty products may qualify for: 
• Replacement  
• Repair  
• Full refund  
after inspection.
